description: This file declares functions related to merge operations in a version control system, specifically wrapping 'merge-ort' algorithms for non-recursive, recursive, and generic merging strategies. It serves as an interface providing prototypes for merge functions.

methods.name: merge_ort_nonrecursive
methods.description: Performs a non-recursive, rename-detecting three-way merge, mimicking the behavior of 'merge_trees()'.

methods.name: merge_ort_recursive
methods.description: Performs a recursive, rename-detecting three-way merge with ancestor consolidation, mimicking 'merge_recursive()'.

methods.name: merge_ort_generic
methods.description: Performs a merge with a specified number of merge bases, with optional recursive ancestor consolidation, mimicking 'merge_recursive_generic()'.
